RORK MAX — IVX IA CHAT PRODUCTION DEFECT AUDIT + FIX + DEPLOY NOW

THIS IS A P0 PRODUCTION DEFECT.

NO NARRATIVE REPORT FIRST.
NO NEW CERTIFICATION.
NO PERCENTAGE ESTIMATES.
NO CLAIMING "FIXED" FROM LOCAL CODE.

AUDIT THE LIVE IVX IA CHAT, MODIFY THE REAL SOURCE CODE,
TEST IT, PUSH IT, DEPLOY IT, AND QA THE DEPLOYED VERSION.

==================================================
OBSERVED PRODUCTION FAILURES — OWNER QA
==================================================

The owner has tested the live application and confirmed:

DEFECT 1 — LANGUAGE

User asks in Spanish:

"Cual es tu nombre? Y quien es tu dueno"

IVX answers in English.

FAIL.

Required behavior:

Detect the language of the current user message/conversation.

Spanish → answer naturally in Spanish.
English → answer in English.

Do NOT force English through system prompts, templates,
identity responses or fallback responses.

==================================================
DEFECT 2 — OLD LOADING/BANNER UI STILL LIVE
==================================================

Production still visibly displays:

"IVX AI WORKING — Working — in progress"

"Still working... 2s"

Cancel panel

large watchdog/status banner

spinner

"IVX is typing..."

This is NOT the approved chat UX.

The owner explicitly requested these routine banners removed.

For NORMAL CHAT there must be NO:

IVX AI WORKING banner
Still working banner
watchdog banner
elapsed-time banner
BACKEND_POST_STARTED display
large Cancel status card
generic working card
routine operational telemetry
full-screen/blocking spinner

These states may exist internally for diagnostics.

THEY MUST NOT RENDER IN NORMAL CHAT.

==================================================
DEFECT 3 — DUPLICATE LOADING STATES
==================================================

The screenshot proves multiple simultaneous loading indicators:

working banner
+
still-working banner
+
spinner
+
typing indicator

FAIL.

Normal chat is allowed ONE minimal transient indicator only:

IVX is typing...

It disappears immediately when the first real response delta
is rendered.

==================================================
DEFECT 4 — RESPONSE IS TOO SLOW
==================================================

Audit the REAL production request path.

Measure timestamps for:

T0 user presses Send
T1 frontend request starts
T2 backend receives request
T3 provider request starts
T4 provider first real delta received
T5 browser/mobile receives first delta
T6 first visible text rendered
T7 response completed
T8 persistence completed

Calculate:

frontend overhead
backend pre-provider overhead
provider TTFT
network/stream overhead
time-to-first-visible-token
total completion time

DO NOT call performance PASS without these measurements.

==================================================
DEFECT 5 — STREAMING MUST BE REAL
==================================================

Determine whether production currently does:

REAL PROVIDER STREAMING

or

WAIT FOR COMPLETE RESPONSE → DISPLAY RESULT.

Also detect fake streaming such as:

setTimeout
setInterval
character reveal
word reveal
splitting completed response
simulated typing

Fake streaming is FAIL.

Required:

PROVIDER
→ backend streaming transport
→ frontend stream reader
→ incremental deltas
→ immediate React state update
→ visible progressive assistant message

The user must see actual answer content while the model is
still generating.

==================================================
DEFECT 6 — LATEST UPDATE MAY NOT BE DEPLOYED
==================================================

Do not assume the latest local code is production.

Immediately determine:

LOCAL SHA
GITHUB MAIN SHA
RENDER DEPLOY SHA
LIVE RUNTIME SHA

Compare all four.

If they differ:

identify exactly which commit contains the chat UX changes.

Push the verified change to canonical GitHub.

Trigger/verify Render deployment.

Then prove:

GITHUB MAIN SHA
=
RENDER DEPLOY SHA
=
LIVE RUNTIME SHA

Do not call the issue fixed before parity exists.

==================================================
PHASE A — FIND THE REAL RENDERING CODE
==================================================

Search the actual codebase for ALL strings/components/state
responsible for the visible production UI.

Search at minimum for:

"IVX AI WORKING"
"Working — in progress"
"Still working"
"IVX is typing"
"Tap to open Watchdog drawer"
"BACKEND_POST_STARTED"
"Cancel"
"Assistant ready"

Also inspect variables/components involving:

isLoading
loading
working
isWorking
thinking
isThinking
processing
streaming
typing
watchdog
elapsed
traceId
lastReached
backendPostStarted

Return exact source files/components found.

Then MODIFY the real rendering path.

Do not merely hide text while leaving another component active.

==================================================
PHASE B — NORMAL CHAT STATE MACHINE
==================================================

Implement one deterministic state machine.

NORMAL CHAT:

IDLE
→ REQUESTING
→ STREAMING
→ COMPLETE

REQUESTING:
show ONLY minimal typing indicator.

STREAMING:
render real assistant text progressively.
Remove typing indicator on FIRST REAL DELTA.

COMPLETE:
no loading UI remains.

ERROR:
show compact error UI.

No other routine banners.

==================================================
PHASE C — REAL AUTONOMOUS JOBS
==================================================

Do NOT remove legitimate autonomous execution visibility.

A REAL autonomous development task may display:

job ID
queued
running
testing
deploying
verifying
completed
failed
blocked

But only if a REAL backend autonomous job exists.

NORMAL conversational messages must never receive autonomous
work banners merely because the prompt contains words like:

work
fix
build
developer
task
analyze

==================================================
PHASE D — CRASH/ERROR BANNERS ONLY
==================================================

Large/prominent banners are reserved for genuine exceptional
conditions:

CRASH
UNRECOVERABLE ERROR
NETWORK FAILURE
AI PROVIDER FAILURE
AUTH FAILURE
TIMEOUT
BLOCKED AUTONOMOUS JOB
OWNER ACTION REQUIRED

Watchdog telemetry must remain hidden from normal users unless
a genuine failure threshold is reached or the user explicitly
opens diagnostics.

==================================================
PHASE E — LANGUAGE FIX
==================================================

Trace:

system prompt
identity brain
conversation brain
fallback handler
owner AI prompt
provider prompt
response post-processing

Find why the Spanish question received an English response.

Implement:

Respond primarily in the language used by the user unless the
user explicitly requests another language.

Do not hardcode only Spanish/English if the underlying model
can naturally support multilingual conversation.

Test at minimum:

Spanish
English

Also verify mixed-language follow-up behavior.

==================================================
PHASE F — RESPONSE QUALITY
==================================================

For simple questions, do not return unnecessary corporate
identity narrative.

Example:

USER:
"Cual es tu nombre? Y quien es tu dueño?"

Expected style:

"Me llamo IVX IA. Soy el asistente de IA de IVX Holdings."

Then answer additional context only if useful.

Do not automatically append:

long capability description
marketing text
"what would you like to know?"
unrequested system explanation

Preserve intelligence, but make normal conversation concise
and natural.

==================================================
PHASE G — STREAM IMPLEMENTATION
==================================================

Inspect actual AI gateway/provider capabilities.

If streaming is supported, use the real streaming interface.

Use the appropriate existing architecture:

SSE
fetch ReadableStream
streaming HTTP
or equivalent.

Do not invent a second chat architecture unnecessarily.

Structured events should clearly distinguish:

response.started
response.delta
response.completed
response.error

Tool/autonomous events must be separate from conversational
text deltas.

==================================================
PHASE H — PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Do NOT create a database row for every token.

Maintain one assistant message.

During streaming:
update in-memory visible message.

At completion:
persist canonical final response.

Verify:

no duplicates
correct ordering
reload preserves response
conversation history correct
failed stream does not corrupt conversation

==================================================
PHASE I — STOP GENERATION
==================================================

Keep a small Stop control only while a real request/stream is
active.

It must abort the real request.

After abort:

no spinner
no typing indicator
no working banner
partial text preserved appropriately
request state cleaned

==================================================
PHASE J — TESTS
==================================================

Add/run automated tests proving:

01 Spanish prompt → Spanish response
02 English prompt → English response
03 normal chat → no IVX AI WORKING banner
04 normal chat → no Still working banner
05 normal chat → no watchdog banner
06 normal chat → no blocking spinner
07 only one pre-token typing indicator
08 first real delta removes typing indicator
09 deltas progressively update assistant message
10 completed response persists
11 reload does not duplicate response
12 provider error displays error UI
13 normal success displays no error banner
14 abort cleans state
15 real autonomous job can show job status
16 normal chat cannot fabricate autonomous status
17 watchdog internal telemetry does not leak into normal UI

All relevant existing regression suites must remain green.

==================================================
PHASE K — DEPLOY
==================================================

After tests pass:

COMMIT
PUSH TO CANONICAL GITHUB
DEPLOY RENDER
WAIT FOR DEPLOYMENT
VERIFY RUNTIME SHA

No local-only PASS.

==================================================
PHASE L — LIVE PRODUCTION QA
==================================================

TEST THE DEPLOYED IVX CHAT.

LIVE TEST 1:

"Cual es tu nombre? Y quien es tu dueño?"

Required:

Spanish response
no large banners
no watchdog
no Still working card
no blocking spinner
one subtle typing state before first token
real progressive text

LIVE TEST 2:

"What is your name and who is your owner?"

Required:

English response
same clean streaming UX

LIVE TEST 3:

Ask a substantial business-analysis question.

Verify real streaming and measure TTFT.

LIVE TEST 4:

Ask a senior software-development QUESTION that does NOT
create a development job.

Verify it remains normal conversational streaming.

LIVE TEST 5:

Create one REAL autonomous development job.

Only here verify real job status UI.

==================================================
EVIDENCE GATE
==================================================

Every PASS must come from actual execution.

Do not claim:

STREAMING PASS
DEPLOYED
PRODUCTION PASS
SHA PARITY
LANGUAGE PASS
PERFORMANCE PASS

without corresponding runtime evidence.

Never fabricate screenshots, logs, SHAs, requests or results.

==================================================
RETURN ONLY AFTER EXECUTION
==================================================

ROOT CAUSES:
<exact findings>

FILES CHANGED:
<exact files>

LANGUAGE FIX:
PASS / FAIL

SPANISH LIVE QA:
PASS / FAIL

ENGLISH LIVE QA:
PASS / FAIL

OLD WORKING BANNER REMOVED:
PASS / FAIL

STILL-WORKING BANNER REMOVED:
PASS / FAIL

WATCHDOG NORMAL-CHAT BANNER REMOVED:
PASS / FAIL

BLOCKING SPINNER REMOVED:
PASS / FAIL

SINGLE TYPING INDICATOR:
PASS / FAIL

REAL PROVIDER STREAMING:
PASS / FAIL

FAKE STREAMING:
FOUND / NOT FOUND

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

DUPLICATES:
0 / <number>

PASS / FAIL

NORMAL CHAT JOB FALSE-POSITIVES:
0 / <number>

TIME TO FIRST VISIBLE TOKEN:

LOCAL SHA:

<sha>

<sha>

REMAINING DEFECTS:
<NONE or exact list>

FINAL VERDICT:

IVX IA CHAT REAL-TIME UX — PRODUCTION VERIFIED

or

IVX IA CHAT REAL-TIME UX — NOT VERIFIED

DO THE CODE WORK NOW.
DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER NARRATIVE STATUS REPORT FIRST.
